en.headline: Tung Chung Line to close early on 28 November
en.dek: Trains between Tung Chung and Sunny Bay will end around 11pm that night for a key turnout installation on the extension.
body: MTR services between Tung Chung and Sunny Bay will finish at about 11pm on 28 November, roughly two hours earlier than usual, so engineers can install a key turnout on the Tung Chung Line extension.

The corporation said the last train from Tung Chung to Hong Kong that night will leave at 11.02pm, and the last train from Hong Kong to Tung Chung at 11.07pm. After that, trains leaving Hong Kong will terminate at Sunny Bay. Free shuttle buses will run between Tung Chung and Sunny Bay until the normal end of service.

This is the third installation of its kind on the project, intended to let trains later divert towards Tung Chung East station. The MTR said the work has to run continuously and be fully tested afterwards, so the non-traffic maintenance window has to be extended. It said it would try to complete the works so that normal service can resume from the first train the following day.
The fourth and final turnout installation is expected next year.

zh.headline: 東涌綫11月28日晚上提早收車
zh.dek: 港鐵稱當晚東涌至欣澳列車約晚上11時結束，以配合延綫第三次關鍵道岔安裝，並設免費接駁巴士。
body: 港鐵東涌綫往來東涌站與欣澳站的列車，將於11月28日晚上約11時結束服務，較平常提早約兩小時，以便進行東涌綫延綫的關鍵道岔安裝。
港鐵表示，當晚東涌往香港站的尾班車於晚上11時02分開出，香港站往東涌的尾班車於晚上11時07分開出。其後由香港站開出的列車以欣澳為總站。東涌與欣澳之間會有免費接駁巴士，直至原本收車時間。
這是項目第三次進行同類工序，讓列車日後可改道前往東涌東站。港鐵指工程需要連續進行，完成後亦要全面測試，因此非行車維修時段須暫時延長。公司表示會盡力確保工程順利，讓翌日頭班車起恢復正常服務。
第四次、亦即最後一次道岔安裝，預計於明年進行。
